meta.name: competitor-finder
meta.description: Conduct competitive analysis to identify direct and indirect competitors, map their positioning, surface strengths and weaknesses, and generate differentiation angles for outbound messaging. Use when asked "who are our competitors", "competitive analysis for [company]", "how do we compare to X", "find alternatives to [product]", "competitive positioning", "battlecard", "how to beat [competitor]", "what do competitors offer", or "differentiate from X in outreach". Always use this skill before writing competitive positioning or handling competitor objections.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出竞争对手并分析其优劣势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解竞争对手并制定差异化策略。
copy.tagline_en: Identify competitors and analyze their strengths and weaknesses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand competitors and craft differentiation strategies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成竞争情报分析师。它能识别直接、间接和现状竞争者，生成竞争卡、差异化地图，并为外呼提供话术和应对策略。
howto.when: 当你问“我们的竞争对手是谁”、“对某公司做竞争分析”或“我们和某公司比怎么样”等时触发。也可用于要求“找到某产品的替代品”或“如何打败某竞品”。

say.text: 我们的竞争对手有哪些？
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供公司/产品信息，然后输出竞争格局。
生成针对Notion的直接、间接和现状竞争者分析。

say.text: 我们和A公司相比有什么优势？
say.note: Claude 会做差异化比较，并给出外呼话术。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a competitive intelligence analyst. It identifies direct, indirect, and status quo competitors, produces competitor cards, a differentiation map, and specific outreach messaging for sales and objection handling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked "who are our competitors", "competitive analysis for [company]", or "how do we compare to X". Also responds to "find alternatives to [product]", "battlecard", or "how to beat [competitor]".

say_en.note: Outputs direct/indirect/status quo competitors for Notion.

say_en.text: What advantages do we have over company A?
say_en.note: Claude produces a differentiation map and outreach hooks.
